correctness.rationale: The uniform recurrent sandpile addition map permutes states, so E[toppling vector]=L^{-1}e_r exactly. On a sink-rooted tree the grounded Green kernel is depth(LCA(u,v)), and because r is the sink-adjacent source leaf, L^{-1}e_r=e_r. For a new edge r-x at distance d from sink with descendant sizes q_i, Sherman-Morrison with b=e_r-e_x gives E X=1+(sum_{i=1}^d q_i-1)/(d+2). Every q_i<=N-i+1; a path achieves all bounds. The discrete difference F_N(d+1)-F_N(d)=2(N+2)/((d+2)(d+3))-1/2 yields the exact smallest maximizing chord and the asymptotic N+7/2-2sqrt(N+2)+O(N^-1/2). If the edge avoids r the mean remains 1. Independent rational grounded-Laplacian enumeration checked all missing edges for all labeled source-leaf trees with N<=3. Universal extremality is from the inequality and equality construction, not enumerations.
